summary: A profile minute reports each reconcile stage's reads: bytes read from disk and bytes read in all, so a stage's page-cache misses show apart from the pages it served from memory

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Two fields are added to each span in the profile's minutes and slow records; readers that ignore unknown fields are unaffected. Item spans report zero.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure; profiling still runs only with ST3_PROFILE_DIR.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build drops the two fields.
